propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys (jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses) have no active reader after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port and classify_probe_response function

The keys were behaviour-affecting in shipped release v0.10.1 via adapters/jira/probe.py::_resolve_resolved_statuses and became inert only by v0.11.0, making hard removal an upgrade hazard for deployed systems
The keys are registered as scheduled deprecations in _deprecations.py with empty replacement and removal target v1.0.0, still parsing and validating identically while emitting a deprecation warning

Write-only DC transport plumbing (_TransportBase.resolved_statuses param/attribute, JiraDataCenterSettings.resolved_statuses field, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES constant, backend.py ctor kwarg) has been removed as behaviour-neutral since nothing read the stored value
Config-read gate validation now pins two read-via markers pointing to follow-up ticket f408-64ad-ee41-46b6 for hard removal once operator sign-off is obtained

Documentation in config.md and user-guide.md updated to describe both keys as deprecated, warning, and scheduled for removal in v1.0.0, fixing pre-existing inconsistency in which key owned the f020/inert story
